กลองเงียบแล้ว... เมื่อคืนเป็นคืนแรกที่คน:
The drum has gone quiet... Last night was the first night the town slept without jolting awake at the thunder.

Bronn didn't beat that drum because he wanted to. He was bound to it, like everyone else in this tower.

ได้ยินเสียงนั่นไหม... ฟ้าร้องเหนือชั้น 5:
Do you hear that...? The thunder above floor 50 isn't coming from a storm. It's a drum.

Bronn, the Thunder Herald, beats his drum to send the hammer-bearer's orders down the trunk. Every time it sounds, the people below kneel without knowing why. Climb to floor 55 and silence that drum.

ฝนตกลงมาที่อัมเบอร์เฮเวนทั้งคืน ผู้เฒ่าค:
It rained over Emberhaven all night. An old man stood weeping in the rain, saying he heard his daughter calling.

I wrote down seventeen names I heard in that rain... more than I've found all year.
เมฆเหนือชั้น 55 ไม่ได้ลอยไปตามลม มันถูกต:
The clouds above floor 55 don't drift with the wind. They are herded.

Mekha gathers the names the temple erased and shapes them into clouds, keeping them as a flock atop the tree. Those names were once people... Climb to floor 60 and let that flock fall as rain on their homes.

สะพานที่ไม่ยอมให้ข้าม: The Bridge That Would Not Be Crossed
สะพานร้าวทั้งเส้น แต่ยังยืนอยู่... เหมือ:
The bridge is cracked end to end, but it still stands... like the people here.

Before she fell, Iris told you a rainbow has seven colors, but the hammer ordered it to keep only one. I'm not sure if she meant the bridge, or us.
เหนือเมฆขึ้นไปคือสะพานรุ้ง — หรือสิ่งที่:
Above the clouds lies the rainbow bridge — or what's left of it.

Iris guards the bridge and lets only those bearing the hammer's mark pass. You haven't bowed to the hammer since Jotunheim, so the bridge won't accept you. You'll have to get past Iris and reach floor 65 on your own.
ขึ้นหออิกดราซิลจนผ่านชั้น 70 (ผู้คุม: กร: Climb Yggdrasil Tower past floor 70 (warden: Grimnir, Jailer of Forgotten Gods), then return to Svala.
ขึ้นหอไปให้ถึงชั้น 70 แล้วกลับมาหาข้า —: Climb to floor 70 of the tower, then come back to me — you can choose your starting floor at the Root Stone.
ชื่อบางชื่อในทะเบียนไม่ใช่ชื่อคน ข้าเพิ่:
Some names in the register aren't people's names. I only just made them out — they're the names of gods. Gods of the Vanir, of the giants, and of those no one writes about anymore.

The chronicles say they died in the war, but floors 66 to 70 are a prison, and Grimnir is its jailer. Go up and see who is still locked away.
ผ่านชั้น 70 และกลับรายงานสวาลา: Clear floor 70 and report to Svala
พวกเขาไม่ได้ตาย... ถูกลืมแค่นั้นเอง และก:
They didn't die... they were only forgotten. And in this tower, being forgotten means being imprisoned forever.

One of the gods sent you a message: «Those who write history never lose a war.» I don't want to believe who he meant.
ขึ้นหออิกดราซิลจนผ่านชั้น 75 (ผู้คุม: เฮ: Climb Yggdrasil Tower past floor 75 (warden: Helga, the Broken-Spear Valkyrie), then return to Svala.
ขึ้นหอไปให้ถึงชั้น 75 แล้วกลับมาหาข้า —: Climb to floor 75 of the tower, then come back to me — you can choose your starting floor at the Root Stone.
ผ่านชั้น 75 และกลับรายงานสวาลา: Clear floor 75 and report to Svala
วาลคีรีเคยเลือกนักรบที่ตายในสนามรบขึ้นไป:
The valkyries once chose warriors who fell in battle to join the gods' army. Helga was one of them.

One day she refused an order, and her spear broke in midair. She has been pinned to the Spear Court ever since. Reach floor 75 and free her from a duty she never chose.
หอกที่หักกลางอากาศ: The Spear That Broke in Midair
เฮลกาบอกว่าคำสั่งที่นางปฏิเสธ คือให้เลือ:
Helga says the order she refused was to choose "the living" instead of the dead — the hammer-bearer wants an army that never runs out.

The hundred names in the register... that is the army he is building.
ขึ้นหออิกดราซิลจนผ่านชั้น 80 (ผู้คุม: เอ: Climb Yggdrasil Tower past floor 80 (warden: Eon, Keeper of the Last Hour), then return to Svala.
ขึ้นหอไปให้ถึงชั้น 80 แล้วกลับมาหาข้า —: Climb to floor 80 of the tower, then come back to me — you can choose your starting floor at the Root Stone.
ผู้คนเชื่อว่าราคนาร็อกคือวันสิ้นโลกที่ไม:
People believe Ragnarok is an end of the world no one can escape. But if it truly can't be escaped... why would anyone need to guard the clock counting down to it?

Above the Spear Court is the Clocktower at Time's End. Eon guards the hand that counts down to the next end of the world. Climb to floor 80 and see what day that hand points to.
ผ่านชั้น 80 และกลับรายงานสวาลา: Clear floor 80 and report to Svala
เข็มชี้ไปที่ \"เมื่อผู้คนเริ่มสงสัย\" ไม:
The hand points to "when people begin to doubt" — not to any day at all.

Whenever enough people ask questions, the world is ended again and begins anew with a fresh chronicle. You stopped that hand... at least for this cycle.
ขึ้นหออิกดราซิลจนผ่านชั้น 85 (ผู้คุม: สค: Climb Yggdrasil Tower past floor 85 (warden: Skrif, Burner of Chronicles), then return to Svala.
ขึ้นหอไปให้ถึงชั้น 85 แล้วกลับมาหาข้า —: Climb to floor 85 of the tower, then come back to me — you can choose your starting floor at the Root Stone.
ผ่านชั้น 85 และกลับรายงานสวาลา: Clear floor 85 and report to Svala
หน้าแรกของพงศาวดารฉบับแรก...\n\n\"ในปีที:
The first page of the first chronicle...

"In the years when the tree still bore fruit, the thunder god arrived with a hammer and a promise to protect. He gave a name to everything, and whatever refused the name he gave was called a demon."

Thor didn't protect the world from demons... he was the one who decided who the demons were.
เหนือหอนาฬิกาคือหอจดหมายเหตุที่ไม่มีใครไ:
Above the clocktower is an archive no one is permitted to read. For thousands of years Skrif has had one duty — to burn the old chronicle every time a new one is finished.

Climb to floor 85 and bring me the pages that haven't burned. I want to know what the first chronicle said.
ขึ้นหออิกดราซิลจนผ่านชั้น 90 (ผู้คุม: เน: Climb Yggdrasil Tower past floor 90 (warden: Nidr, Gnawer of the Throne Roots), then return to Svala.
ขึ้นหอไปให้ถึงชั้น 90 แล้วกลับมาหาข้า —: Climb to floor 90 of the tower, then come back to me — you can choose your starting floor at the Root Stone.
บ่อน้ำที่วานาเฮมแห้ง ไฟรากของช่างวานาเฮม:
The wells of Vanaheim ran dry. The Vanaheim smiths' root-fire grows weaker every year. The trees bear less fruit everywhere — you've seen it all along the way.

It isn't because the world is old. Something is gnawing Yggdrasil's roots from beneath the throne atop the tower. Nidr guards floor 90. Go see with your own eyes who it feeds those roots to.
ผ่านชั้น 90 และกลับรายงานสวาลา: Clear floor 90 and report to Svala
รูน «ดูด» บนหัวค้อนที่คนแคระถูกสั่งให้สล:
The «drain» rune on the hammer's head that the dwarves were ordered to carve... it doesn't only drain the one who wields it. Every prayer people send to Thor flows up through the roots to feed the throne. The tree isn't old... it's being sucked dry.

We were taught to thank Thor for the rain. But the rain that falls is only the scraps of what he takes.
ขึ้นหออิกดราซิลจนผ่านชั้น 95 (ผู้คุม: ลุ: Climb Yggdrasil Tower past floor 95 (warden: Lygnir, Weaver of Lies), then return to Svala.
ขึ้นหอไปให้ถึงชั้น 95 แล้วกลับมาหาข้า —: Climb to floor 95 of the tower, then come back to me — you can choose your starting floor at the Root Stone.
ผ่านชั้น 95 และกลับรายงานสวาลา: Clear floor 95 and report to Svala
เช้านี้ฟ้าเหนืออัมเบอร์เฮเวนเป็นสีเทา ไม:
This morning the sky over Emberhaven was gray, with no golden light. The whole town was in shock... but for the first time, we saw the real sky.

And a great gate at the top of the tower that no one knew existed.
แสงสีทองที่ผู้คนเห็นบนท้องฟ้าทุกเช้า และ:
The golden light people see in the sky every morning and call Asgard's blessing...

Lygnir weaves it from lies, thread by thread, every night. That web hides whatever lies above the tower. Climb to floor 95 and cut that sky apart.
ขึ้นหออิกดราซิลจนผ่านชั้น 100 (ผู้คุม: เ: Climb Yggdrasil Tower past floor 100 (warden: Shadow of the Hammer, Warden of the Golden Gate), then return to Svala.
ขึ้นหอไปให้ถึงชั้น 100 แล้วกลับมาหาข้า —: Climb to floor 100 of the tower, then come back to me — you can choose your starting floor at the Root Stone.
คนแปลกหน้าคนนั้น... ที่เคยบอกเจ้าว่ามีพี:
That stranger... the one who once told you he had a brother who bears a hammer. He was waiting at the gate?

If he opened it for you, then he has been waiting a long time for someone to make it that far... Go. Asgard awaits. I'll write your name as the first one in the new register.
ชั้น 100 คือประตูแอสการ์ด ผู้เฝ้าประตูไม:
Floor 100 is the Gate of Asgard. Its warden has no name and no face — it is only the shadow of the hammer, a shadow Thor left behind to pass judgment in his stead.

You've walked farther than any bearer of the ninth edge ever has. Reach floor 100, then come back and tell me what waits behind that gate.
ผ่านชั้น 100 และกลับรายงานสวาลา: Clear floor 100 and report to Svala
